success_criteria.note: The STRONG and VERY_STRONG rungs are byte-identical to Stage 2 so the three stages remain directly comparable. Stage 2's ladder had no rung between a 10% cost win and failure, which the Stage 2 calibration evidence showed is a wide gap: Condition A is roughly twice as hard as Condition B at every capacity. The PARTIAL rung below was added before any Stage 3 evaluation was run and no threshold was moved to accommodate a measured result.

no_go.rule: any suite-level capacity with C_Stage3 > 1.03 * C_Stage1, or fewer than three non-degenerate capacities with a strictly positive improvement whose paired 95% interval excludes zero

success_criteria.precedence: NO_GO first; then VERY_STRONG_SUCCESS; then STRONG_SUCCESS; then PARTIAL_SUCCESS; then WEAK; otherwise NO_GO

regression_criterion.reporting: every flagged regression is reported even when the aggregate result is positive

statistics.paired_unit: source decode sequence, stratified by domain
statistics.primary_suite_aggregation: At each capacity, sum raw unit-miss costs across all ten frozen workload paths; no per-capacity, per-regime or per-workload variant reselection.
statistics.conditionality: Intervals reweight saved per-sequence contributions conditional on each frozen stateful workload path; stateful cache trajectories are not regenerated under reordered bootstrap workloads.
